title: Western and Vedic
lines: Two lenses on the same sky.
Western reads the seasons; Vedic reads the stars. Within shows you both, side by side.
caption:

title: Around 29, and again at 58
lines: Saturn comes back to where it was when you were born.
It's a season of growing up and building what lasts.
caption:
What is a Saturn return? ♄

About every 29 years Saturn comes back to where it was when you were born: around 29, 58 and 88. It's a season of growing up, letting go, and building what lasts.
